scope: Manifest-listed eight bankruptcy issuers. Records summarize plan treatment only; they are not exchange settlement prices, liquidation proceeds per share, or broker-level cash receipts. Null means no verified universal per-share cash amount.

records.shareholder_plan_treatment: Existing common shares canceled; plan contains separate settlement treatment for certain holders/claims; do not infer universal per-share cash recovery.
All outstanding common shares and equity awards extinguished and canceled on plan effective date.
Existing Acorda interests extinguished/canceled; no distribution or recovery under plan.
Pre-emergence equity canceled; no recovery under plan; new equity allocated through restructuring to creditors.
Pre-emergence Class A interests canceled; no recovery or distribution.
Existing equity interests canceled and receive no distribution under plan.
Existing Parent Equity Interests canceled; no distribution or retained property under plan.

Contingent: if eligible equity classes voted to accept plan, holders could receive pro rata share of $20m cash pool or elect new equity pool; if either class rejected, no distribution and cancellation. Per-share realized recovery requires holder election and class-level allocation.
